facts.statement: Joined Shiftwell, a scheduling and HR SaaS company for hourly workforces, as a senior backend engineer
Promoted to staff engineer at Shiftwell in 2021
Tech lead for extracting five services (Go, Postgres, Kafka) out of the Rails monolith, with a team of six engineers
Cut the nightly payroll export from about six hours to about forty minutes
Deploys for the extracted services dropped from about 45 minutes to about 12 minutes
Turned down an offer to become the platform team's engineering manager in 2022

facts.statement: Owned the double-entry ledger service at Tallyline, a payments startup in Austin
Migrated about 900 million historical transactions into the new ledger after three months of dual writes
Cut over to the new ledger with zero downtime
Nightly reconciliation surfaced about $41,000 of old discrepancies
Incident lead for the Thanksgiving 2017 duplicate payout incident: about 1,100 merchants paid twice, about $380,000, all but about $12,000 recovered in two weeks
Added idempotency keys across the whole payout path after the incident
The ledger handled about $2 billion a year by 2018
Took a career break from spring 2023 through 2025 to care for his father after a stroke
Moved from Austin back to Atlanta (Decatur) in 2023
Wrote pgledger, an open-source double-entry ledger library in Go on Postgres, with about 640 GitHub stars
Wrote tollgate, an open-source distributed rate limiter in Go backed by Redis
Held a Secret clearance at Redstone Ridge Systems, a defense contractor in Huntsville, from 2009; it has since lapsed
Rewrote the telemetry decoder's buffering and threading, cutting dropped frames from about 2% to under 0.1%
Four-month contract at Lumenrent building ACH return reconciliation for about 14,000 rent payments a month, cutting monthly reconciliation from about two days to about two hours
